cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - RoundedBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with vertical edges rounded
Default: edge_style = f Finger Joint: ![Finger Joint](static/samples/RoundedBox-2.jpg)
Alternative: edge_style = h Edge (parallel Finger Joint Holes): ![Finger Joint Holes](static/samples/RoundedBox-3.jpg)
With lid:
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes RoundedBox --x 140 --y 90 --sh '40*3' --radius 20 --wallpieces 2 --top lid --thickness 4 --burn 0.15 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes RoundedBox --x --y --sh --radius --wallpieces --top --thickness --burn --reference --labels
